'''Zacariah Nemo''' is a ship Engineer based at '''Nemo Cyber Party Base''' in the '''Yoru''' system. He specialises in projectile weapons, particularly [[Fragment Cannon|Fragment Cannons]].<ref name="edwiki-nemo">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Zacariah_Nemo Zacariah Nemo], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Nemo provides '''Grade 5''' Fragment Cannon engineering, [[Multi-Cannon]] engineering through Grade 3, and [[Plasma Accelerator]] engineering through Grade 2.<ref name="inara-nemo">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/9/ Zacariah Nemo — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

== Location ==

* '''System:''' Yoru
* '''Body:''' Yoru 4
* '''Facility:''' Nemo Cyber Party Base
* '''Engineer scope:''' Ship weapons
* '''Referral required:''' [[Elvira Martuuk]]
* '''System permit required:''' No

== Access requirements ==

Access to Zacariah Nemo has three stages:<ref name="inara-nemo" /><ref name="edwiki-nemo" />

# Reach '''Grade 3 access plus at least one-third progress toward Grade 4''' with [[Elvira Martuuk]] to receive his referral.
# Reach at least '''Friendly''' reputation with the '''Party of Yoru''' and obtain its Engineer invitation.
# Provide '''25 units of Xihe Biomorphic Companions''' at Nemo Cyber Party Base.

The referral, minor-faction invitation, and commodity contribution are separate conditions. The complete ordered process, including faction reputation and rare-commodity delivery, belongs to [[Unlocking Zacariah Nemo]].

== Workshop reputation ==

Reputation with Zacariah Nemo increases by:<ref name="inara-nemo" />

* crafting modifications at his workshop; or
* selling commodities at Nemo Cyber Party Base.

Higher reputation opens the grades that Nemo supports. INARA notes that station services may not appear immediately after the first unlock; beginning a new game session can make those services available.<ref name="inara-nemo" />

The available modification families, effects, trade-offs, and recipes belong to [[Engineering Blueprints]]. Compatible secondary modifications belong to [[Experimental Effects]].

=== Operations-era services ===

Current Live records add two Operations-era services to Nemo's workshop:<ref name="frontier-operations">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-0-0 Elite Dangerous: Operations — Update Notes], Frontier Developments, 30 June 2026. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="inara-nemo" />

* '''Double Screaming''' [[Fragment Cannon]] engineering through Grade 5<ref name="inara-double">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/215/ Fragment Cannon — Double Screaming], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>
* '''Rapid Phase''' [[Multi-Cannon]] engineering through Grade 3<ref name="inara-rapid">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/223/ Multi-Cannon — Rapid Phase], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

These services are not part of Legacy Engineering. Their exact modifiers, costs, and module compatibility belong to the corresponding [[Engineering Blueprints|Blueprint]] records rather than this Engineer article.

== Blueprint pinning and remote work ==

After sufficient reputation has been earned, one Zacariah Nemo blueprint can be pinned for use through [[Remote Engineering]]. A pinned blueprint cannot exceed the grade he offers, and Experimental Effects still require an appropriate workshop visit.

== Direct referrals ==

Zacariah Nemo has no currently documented direct downstream Engineer referral. Other branches of the network can be followed through [[Engineer Unlock Guide]].
